original_problem: Static security analyzer flagged potential DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in markdown preview widget.
verified_root_cause: Raw HTML rendering was enabled without DOMPurify sanitization hook, permitting inline script injection.
solution: Integrated DOMPurify hook with strict ALLOWED_TAGS allow-list and enabled Content-Security-Policy headers.

regression_prevention_strategy.description: Added test injecting and payloads asserting sanitization.

supporting_evidence.verification_output_summary: Passed. All malicious XSS vector strings stripped cleanly. Semgrep security audit zero findings.
